subject: Project Basalt kickoff — AdaRank adaptive-rank LoRA
body:
Hi Bruno, all,

Kicking off our adaptive-rank finetuning effort. Internally we refer to this effort as Project Basalt — please use the codename on decks, calendar invites, and doc titles so tracking stays consistent.

Quick framing: LoRA is almost always applied with one rank across every layer, but the transfer-learning evidence says later layers diverge more from pretrained weights during finetuning. AdaRank predicts a per-module rank from model disagreement, and because it leaves pretraining and adaptation completely intact — no extra objectives or regularizers — it can drop straight into our finetuning service without touching customer workflows.

Milestones inside the window: repro of TREC and yelp_polarity results by Feb 27, adapter-service integration spike through March, internal design review the week of Apr 20. I want us in the platform roadmap conversation before Q2 planning starts.

Thanks,
Dmitri
